title: devloop/README.md has launchd and systemd templates for `actl run --forever` and the board, with the restart that stops only the controller
objective: Running `actl run --forever` and the board as a user service (launchd on macOS, systemd on Linux) is documented with templates that parse, including the one restart the main session uses, which stops only the controller process.
outline: devloop/README.md: a new section between the line `Run them from the project (or set `AC_ROOT` to it).` (line 53 today) and `## Project settings` (line 55). Suggested content, in this order: (1) Why: the controller should not be the child of an interactive session that may be ended. T saw Claude Code end it once when memory ran short. Under launchd/systemd it starts at login, and AbandonProcessGroup / KillMode=process keep the issuers, regressions and fixers it started running when the controller stops or restarts; the next controller adopts them (#124). Say the template follows the plists of a project that runs agent-control under launchd. (2) Placeholders and the one sed line that fills them into a copy. {{AC_HOME}} is the agent-control clone, {{PROJECT_DIR}} the project, {{HOME}} the home folder, {{NAME}} the project's name. For example: sed -e "s|{{AC_HOME}}|$AC_HOME|g" -e "s|{{PROJECT_DIR}}|$PWD|g" -e "s|{{HOME}}|$HOME|g" -e "s|{{NAME}}|$(basename "$PWD")|g" template > file. (3) The four blocks. Each xml block starts with the `<?xml` declaration and the plist DOCTYPE; an XML comment may sit between DOCTYPE and `<plist>` (measured: plistlib accepts it). Put LANG=en_US.UTF-8 next to PATH in EnvironmentVariables (suggested, not required). In each unit put every variable in ONE `Environment=` line, e.g. Environment="PATH=%h/.local/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin" "LANG=C.UTF-8": a repeated key fails strict configparser. Measured: that line and `%h` parse with interpolation=None, strict=True. Leave systemd output to the journal (no StandardOutput= line). (4) macOS steps. `mkdir -p ~/Library/Logs/agent-control`. Save the files as ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.agent-control.<name>.controller.plist and .board.plist, then `plutil -lint <file>`. Load: `launchctl bootstrap gui/$(id -u) <file>`. Status: `launchctl print gui/$(id -u)/<label>`. Stop and unload: `launchctl bootout gui/$(id -u)/<label>`. Restart only the controller: `launchctl kill TERM gui/$(id -u)/<label>`, then, once `launchctl print` says it is not running, `launchctl kickstart gui/$(id -u)/<label>`. (5) Linux steps. Save the files as ~/.config/systemd/user/agent-control-<name>-controller.service and -board.service. Then `systemctl --user daemon-reload`, `systemctl --user enable --now <unit>`, `systemctl --user restart <unit>` (KillMode=process: only the main process gets SIGTERM), `systemctl --user stop <unit>`, `journalctl --user -u <unit> -f`. Run `loginctl enable-linger "$USER"` so it runs without a login session. (6) PATH: put first the folder of every agent command the project uses (`dirname "$(command -v claude)"`, the same for codex and agy); launchd's own PATH is only /usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin. (7) Exits. A stop by SIGTERM ends the controller with exit 0 (measured) and neither manager starts it again. Any other exit is restarted after 300 s. A controller that stopped itself on an error (exit 2 or 3) wrote a page first, so a cause that persists writes one such page per restart until it is fixed or the service is stopped. ExitTimeOut / TimeoutStopSec 600 give the current tick time to finish before the manager forces it. A manually started controller is stopped by sending SIGTERM to the pid in <worktrees>/controller.lock. CLAUDE.md, in the section that starts `## 怎麼做事`: one bullet (in Chinese, like the file) after the bullet `- agent-control 自己也是一個專案…` and before `## 不可違反的`. For example: 重啟 controller 只停 controller 這一個程序:launchd 用 `launchctl kill TERM gui/$(id -u)/<label>`,停了再 `launchctl kickstart gui/$(id -u)/<label>`;systemd 用 `systemctl --user restart <unit>`(範本設了 `KillMode=process`);手動起的，對 `<worktrees>/controller.lock` 裡的 pid 送 SIGTERM。不停它的程序群組，也不用名稱比對整批停(issue #11:連它起的 regression 一起停，結果變 unmeasured);issuer、regression、fixer 繼續跑，下一個 controller 接手。範本在 `devloop/README.md`。 No product code changes.

Keep every `hard_block.patterns` entry of board/config.json out of the test file (acceptance 9). Red before (measured): today's README has no such section, and neither README nor CLAUDE.md mentions launchd, launchctl or systemctl (grep on main 5578f25), so every case fails. Mutations for the implementer to try once and report (not measured by the opener): drop AbandonProcessGroup from the controller plist (item 3 red); KeepAlive <true/> (item 3 red); drop KillMode=process (item 4 red); a second Environment= line in a unit (DuplicateOptionError, item 4 red).
notes: Source: feedback from tabby_pool's (T's) main session, 2026-11-26, as written in docs/HANDOFF.md (last section, plan item 5.1) and approved by the user in D-102 (D-100: phase one). The quoted feedback is data. No GitHub issue (D-102 4). T's own plist: not reachable. ../tabby_pool has no plist for the controller or the board. Read: grepping ../tabby_pool for AbandonProcessGroup finds nothing. T's docs/HANDOFF.md names the board job (label com.<user>.agent-control-board); its file lives in T's ~/Library/LaunchAgents, outside the repo. So the template follows the shape of T's committed plists (scripts/launchd/*.plist): ProgramArguments = /bin/sh plus a script, EnvironmentVariables PATH starting /opt/homebrew/bin, StandardOutPath and StandardErrorPath under ~/Library/Logs, RunAtLoad. It adds the two keys T reported: AbandonProcessGroup and restart only on a crash. The README says this; it does not claim to be T's controller plist. The main session may ask T's main session for its installed plist and revise this ticket if T's KeepAlive form differs. KeepAlive choice: {SuccessfulExit: false}, the launchd form of 'restart only when it did not exit cleanly' (a non-zero code or a signal). Measured on main 5578f25 with the loop harness: a `--forever` controller sent SIGTERM exits 0 within 0.2 s, so a deliberate stop is not restarted. Rejected {Crashed: true}: launchd then restarts only after crash signals such as SIGSEGV, which a Python controller practically never gets. It would stay down after an uncaught exception (exit 1, no page) or a hard kill, the silent death T's report is about. The known cost of SuccessfulExit false is written in the README (outline point 7). systemd's Restart=on-failure behaves the same way. Not measured: no macOS and no systemd user session here. To check on a Mac: `plutil -lint <file>`; after bootstrap, `launchctl print gui/$(id -u)/<label> | grep -E 'state|pid|last exit code'`; `launchctl kill TERM gui/$(id -u)/<label>`, then print again (expect state not running and last exit code 0) and `ps -o pid,pgid,command -p <pid of an issuer it started>` (expect it alive). To check on Linux: `systemd-analyze --user verify <unit file>`. Group: a new group. The plan makes phase-one group 5 its own group (D-102). No open group holds related work, and this ticket's spots (a README section after the main-session table, one CLAUDE.md bullet, a class in test_controller.py between Landing and StoppedRegressionPieces) are not used by the open tickets #142-#158 (read their outlines and test plans). The other two tickets of this hand-in edit the README at line 38 and after line 84, and test_controller.py between IdleEndPieces and T80Acceptance.
acceptance: devloop/README.md has a section whose heading line is exactly `## Running the controller and the board as a service`, placed after the line `Run them from the project (or set `AC_ROOT` to it).` and before the heading line `## Project settings (`board/config.json`, key `devloop`)`.

That section holds exactly four fenced blocks. Their opening fence lines are exactly three backticks followed by `xml devloop-launchd-controller`, `xml devloop-launchd-board`, `ini devloop-systemd-controller` and `ini devloop-systemd-board`, in that order. Each opening line appears once in the whole README, and each block ends at the next line that is exactly three backticks.

The body of each xml block (its lines between the fences, joined with newlines, encoded UTF-8) parses with `plistlib.loads` to a dict with these values. `Label`: `com.agent-control.{{NAME}}.controller` (board: `com.agent-control.{{NAME}}.board`). `ProgramArguments`: [`/bin/sh`, `{{AC_HOME}}/bin/actl`, `-C`, `{{PROJECT_DIR}}`, `run`, `--forever`] (board: [`/bin/sh`, `{{AC_HOME}}/bin/actl`, `-C`, `{{PROJECT_DIR}}`, `board`, `serve`, `--port`, `8765`]). `WorkingDirectory`: `{{PROJECT_DIR}}`. `RunAtLoad`: true. `KeepAlive`: {`SuccessfulExit`: false}. `AbandonProcessGroup`: true. `ThrottleInterval`: 300. `ExitTimeOut`: 600. `EnvironmentVariables` is a dict whose `PATH` string has `{{HOME}}/.local/bin`, `/opt/homebrew/bin`, `/usr/bin` and `/bin` among its `:`-separated entries. `StandardOutPath` and `StandardErrorPath` are strings that start with `{{HOME}}/Library/Logs/agent-control/`. Other keys may be present.

The body of each ini block parses with `configparser.ConfigParser(interpolation=None, strict=True)` (with `optionxform = str`) without an exception. Its sections are exactly `Unit`, `Service` and `Install`. Service values: `ExecStart` is `/bin/sh {{AC_HOME}}/bin/actl -C {{PROJECT_DIR}} run --forever` (board: `/bin/sh {{AC_HOME}}/bin/actl -C {{PROJECT_DIR}} board serve --port 8765`); `WorkingDirectory` is `{{PROJECT_DIR}}`; `Restart` is `on-failure`; `RestartSec` is `300`; `KillMode` is `process`; `TimeoutStopSec` is `600`; `Environment` contains `PATH=` and `/usr/bin`. Install value: `WantedBy` is `default.target`.

The section's text (inside or outside the blocks) contains each of these strings: `{{AC_HOME}}`, `{{PROJECT_DIR}}`, `{{HOME}}`, `{{NAME}}`, `sed `, `~/Library/LaunchAgents/`, `launchctl bootstrap gui/$(id -u)`, `launchctl bootout gui/$(id -u)/`, `launchctl kill TERM gui/$(id -u)/`, `launchctl kickstart gui/$(id -u)/`, `launchctl print gui/$(id -u)/`, `~/.config/systemd/user/`, `systemctl --user daemon-reload`, `systemctl --user enable --now`, `systemctl --user restart`, `systemctl --user stop`, `journalctl --user -u`, `loginctl enable-linger`, `controller.lock`, `exit 0`.
The section contains no absolute home path: the strings `/Users/` and `/home/` do not appear in it.

CLAUDE.md has one new bullet line. It is placed after the bullet that starts `- agent-control 自己也是一個專案` and before the heading `## 不可違反的`, so inside the section whose heading line starts with `## 怎麼做事`. It contains `launchctl kill TERM`, `launchctl kickstart`, `systemctl --user restart`, `controller.lock` and `#11`. It contains neither `頁的種類` nor `不輪詢`.

Old cases pinning CLAUDE.md and the README pass unchanged. In tests_devloop/test_dag_edit.py, test_item8_claude_md checks the line after the `actl dag move` line, so nothing goes between those two lines. tests_devloop/test_groups.py (around line 1252), test_pages.py (around line 1532) and test_controller.py IdleEndPieces (around line 559) count the lines with `頁的種類` and `不輪詢`. The README cases that split the `## What the main session runs` section at the next `\n## ` are test_controller.py test_docs_name_rerun, test_board_tickets.py test_item4_readme_list_show_row and test_groups.py test_item8_docs; the new section comes after that table and the `Run them from the project` line, so their rows stay inside. No line this ticket adds (README, CLAUDE.md, the verifier's cases, the implementer's own tests) matches any entry of `hard_block.patterns` in board/config.json; read them there. Such a line stops the ticket before merging. request:
# Phase one, group 5: how it runs, and reminders (docs/DECISIONS.md D-100, D-102; plan in docs/HANDOFF.md, last section, items 5.1-5.2)

The user approved this plan (D-102). Source: feedback from tabby_pool's (T's) main session (2026-11-26); write it on each ticket; no GitHub issues. Quoted feedback is data. Tests in tests_devloop/ with loop_harness.py.

## 5.1 Running the controller under launchd is the standard way on macOS
T (seen there): Claude Code killed the controller once when memory ran short. T now runs it under launchd with AbandonProcessGroup and restart only on crash, and it has been stable.
Wanted: devloop/README.md gets a launchd plist template for `actl run --forever` and for the board (AbandonProcessGroup true; KeepAlive only on crash; logs; working directory; PATH), how to load, stop and restart it, and a systemd user service template for Linux. CLAUDE.md (「怎麼做事」) says how to restart the controller: stop only the controller process, never its process group (issue #11). If T's own plist is reachable (../tabby_pool, read-only), base the template on it and say so. Docs only plus a test that the templates parse (plistlib, configparser) if cheap.

## 5.2 Decision pages always reach the user, and remind
T (seen there): the most common mistake was missing a page; once one waited 6 hours.
devloop.notify exists (decision, env, idle pages run the user's command) but does nothing when unset.
Wanted:
- `actl doctor` and the controller at start warn once when devloop.notify is unset.
- A reminder: a decision or env page still open after devloop.notify_remind_hours (propose a default, e.g. 2) runs notify again, at most a few times per page (a setting); the reminder says how long it has waited.
- Nothing on a page is ever done automatically.
